env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

cd gapp
logos run .
stdout '^logos-dep-ok$'
stdout '^logos-code-ok$'
stdout '^3 false$'
cp stdout $WORK/b-stdout.txt
logos eject -o bout
exists bout/main.go
exists bout/go.mod
exists bout/_logos_deps/example.com/lp@v1.2.3/p/p.go
grep -count=1 'example\.com/lp v1\.2\.3$' bout/go.mod
grep 'func Code\(\) \(string, error\)' bout/_logos_deps/example.com/lp@v1.2.3/p/p.go
grep 'func Msg\(\) string' bout/_logos_deps/example.com/lp@v1.2.3/p/p.go
grep 'func Pick\(ok bool\) _logos_rt.Option\[int\]' bout/_logos_deps/example.com/lp@v1.2.3/p/p.go
grep 'Option\[int\]' bout/_logos_deps/example.com/lp@v1.2.3/p/p.go
grep 'replace' bout/go.mod
cd bout
go build ./...
go run .
cmp stdout $WORK/b-stdout.txt
# SPEC 0.3: ejected output builds with upstream go1.27.2 from $UPROOT1272.
exists $UPROOT1272/bin/go
exec $UPROOT1272/bin/go version
stdout '^go version go1\.27\.2 '
exec env -u GOROOT $UPROOT1272/bin/go build ./...
cd ..
cd ..

cd lapp
logos run .
stdout '^go-help-ok$'
cp stdout $WORK/a-stdout.txt
logos eject -o ../aout
exists ../aout/main.go
exists ../aout/go.mod
grep -count=1 'example\.com/gohelp v1\.0\.0$' ../aout/go.mod
grep 'replace' ../aout/go.mod
cd ../aout
go build ./...
go run .
cmp stdout $WORK/a-stdout.txt
# SPEC 0.3: ejected output builds with upstream go1.27.2 from $UPROOT1272.
exists $UPROOT1272/bin/go
exec $UPROOT1272/bin/go version
stdout '^go version go1\.27\.2 '
exec env -u GOROOT $UPROOT1272/bin/go build ./...
cd ..

-- lapp/go.mod --
module example.com/lapp

go 1.27

require example.com/gohelp v1.0.0

replace example.com/gohelp v1.0.0 => ../gohelp

-- lapp/main.lgo --
package main

import (
	"fmt"

	"example.com/gohelp/h"
)

func main() {
	fmt.Println(h.Msg())
}

-- gohelp/go.mod --
module example.com/gohelp

go 1.27

-- gohelp/h/h.go --
package h

// Msg reports the Go helper string.
func Msg() string {
	return "go-help-ok"
}

-- gapp/go.mod --
module example.com/gapp

go 1.27

require example.com/lp v1.2.3

replace example.com/lp v1.2.3 => ../lp

-- gapp/main.go --
package main

import (
	"fmt"

	"example.com/lp/p"
)

func main() {
	fmt.Println(p.Msg())
	s, err := p.Code()
	if err != nil {
		fmt.Println("error:", err)
		return
	}
	fmt.Println(s)
	fmt.Println(p.Pick(true).Value, p.Pick(false).Present)
}

-- lp/go.mod --
module example.com/lp

go 1.27

-- lp/p/p.lgo --
package p

// Msg reports the loGo/s helper string.
func Msg() string {
	return "logos-dep-ok"
}

// Code reports the helper string with an error result.
func Code() (string, error) {
	return "logos-code-ok", nil
}

// Pick returns an optional integer.
func Pick(ok bool) int? {
	if ok {
		return 3
	}
	return nil
}
